cards.claim: Temperon achieves 0.8295 ± 0.0034 final test accuracy on CIFAR-100
cards.conditions: ResNet-110 (27.6M params, depth-110 He et al. topology with width 64/128/256), CIFAR-100, 100 epochs, batch 128, bf16, gradient clip 2.0, flip/cutout/colour-jitter augmentation, 5 seeds
cards.effect: Matches full-time SAM+Muon (0.8292 ± 0.0021) with Welch t-test showing no significant difference
cards.evidence: Empirical measurement in controlled pipeline with 5 seeds (42, 1181241943, 958682846, 271828, 314159)

cards.claim: Temperon reaches 0.82 accuracy target on CIFAR-100 in 4643s wall-clock time, 35% faster than full-time SAM+Muon
cards.conditions: ResNet-110 (27.6M params), CIFAR-100, 100 epochs, batch 128, bf16, calibrated against idle-GPU epoch cost
cards.effect: 35% reduction in wall-clock time: 4643s vs 7190s (full SAM+Muon), reaching target in 5/5 seeds
cards.evidence: Calibrated wall-clock time measured as epochs-to-target × idle-GPU-calibrated seconds-per-epoch
cards.quote: reaching the hardest common target 35%...sooner on...CIFAR-100

cards.claim: Temperon exceeds published SAM+SGD recipe by +0.63pp on CIFAR-100 while using comparable wall-clock time
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, same architecture and training setup
cards.effect: +0.63pp accuracy gain (0.8295 vs 0.8232 for published SAM+SGD) at level cost
cards.quote: Against the published SAM+SGD recipe specifically, Temperon is ahead on accuracy on three of four datasets (+0.63pp , +0.27pp , +0.09pp ) at level cost

cards.claim: Muon refiner contributes +0.85pp to CIFAR-100 final accuracy compared to SGD refiner
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, with all other factors fixed (explorer shape, restarts held constant), 5 seeds
cards.effect: Accuracy increases from SGD-refined tier (0.8210–0.8234) to Muon-refined tier (0.8285–0.8295), a +0.85pp difference
cards.evidence: Ablation study (Arm S vs Arm T): swapping only the refiner while holding explorer constant
cards.quote: every SGD-refined arm lands in 0.8210–0.8234, every Muon-refined arm in 0.8285–0.8295, and nothing except the refiner moves an arm between bands... The refiner is the accuracy contribution

cards.claim: Late-phase SAM reaches 0.82 on CIFAR-100 fastest (3022s), beating Temperon and full-time methods at mid-level targets
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, late-phase SAM with 57-epoch budget (matched to Temperon's tail), re-run at tuned hyperparameters in controlled pipeline, 5 seeds
cards.effect: 3022s to reach 0.82 target (5/5 seeds), 35% faster than Temperon (4643s) and 58% faster than full SAM+Muon (7190s)
cards.evidence: Re-run of Zhou et al. method within same experimental pipeline and hardware
cards.quote: It is the fastest measured route to the mid target on every dataset (Table 1): sooner to 0.82 on CIFAR-100

cards.claim: No SGD-refined training method tested reaches 0.83 accuracy on CIFAR-100, while Muon-refined Temperon reaches it
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, comparing all SGD-refined arms (late-phase SAM, published SAM+SGD, ablation Arm S) vs Muon-refined Temperon
cards.effect: Muon creates an accuracy tier (0.83) unreachable by any SGD-refined method: late-phase SAM reaches only 0.8241±0.0009
cards.evidence: Empirical measurement across multiple methods in Table 1 and ablations
cards.quote: It cannot reach the tier the Muon refiner buys: 0.83 on CIFAR-100 in no seed (Temperon: 3/5, at 4870s), 0.97 on CIFAR-10 in no seed (Temperon: 2/5), targets no SGD-refined method touches at all

cards.claim: Plain SGD reaches 0.80 accuracy on CIFAR-100 much faster than any SAM-variant reaches higher targets
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, plain Nesterov SGD only
cards.effect: SGD reaches 0.80 in 1567s; Temperon requires 4416s minimum. Temperon provides no acceleration below SGD's ceiling.
cards.evidence: Measured wall-clock time in experimental pipeline
cards.quote: Plain SGD reaches 0.80 on CIFAR-100 in 1567s; Temperon needs 4416s. Temperon never accelerates a target a cheap method can already reach.

cards.claim: Explorer shape (cyclic restarts) and allocation structure contribute nothing measurable to CIFAR-100 accuracy; only the refiner matters
cards.conditions: CIFAR-100, ResNet-110, ablation Arm T (single cosine explorer with Muon) vs Temperon (cyclic explorer with Muon)
cards.effect: No significant difference: Arm T achieves 0.8288±0.0016 (virtually identical to Temperon 0.8295±0.0034); epochs-to-target both reach 0.82 at epochs 91–94
cards.evidence: Ablation study with statistical testing (Welch t-test shows pp)
